input.prompt: Trail 164 follow-up (https://entire.com/gh/orin-dx/-/trails/164): fix two accuracy bugs in the experimental TypeScript 7.1 checker backend found by trail 172's measurement (PR #320 `measure/checker-modes`; its report and diff lists are described in docs/measurement.md on origin/measure/checker-modes, scratch data in /tmp/claude-501/cm/ pairs.json). Off current origin/main (fetch first). Bug A `fix/checker-keeps-parameter-markers`: the checker's printed function types lose optional and rest markers: structural `(percent?: number, ...) => ReactNode` vs checker `(percent: undefined | number, ...)`, `(...args: any[]) => void` vs `(args: any[]) => void`, `(e?: React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` vs `(e: undefined | MouseEvent<...>)` (antd Circle.format, ActionButton.close, Avatar.onClick; 65 rest/optional losses in the run). Find where the backend turns the checker's type into Caliper's PropType/type text (crates/semantic, crates/tsc-client protocol, core types/semantic.rs merge; docs/type-checker-integration.md says markers are 'not carried'): carry the optional and rest parameter markers through the protocol and the PropType so the checker answer keeps them, if the checker API exposes them (parameter symbol flags, declaration `?`/`...` tokens, `isOptional`, rest parameter detection); if the protocol must change, follow the repo's schema and ADR rules (ADR 0017 optional fields do not bump the schema; check crates/tsc-client protocol versioning). Bug B `fix/checker-underscore-names`: Mantine's `__size`, `__vars`, `__clearable`, `__bottomSection` print as `___size` (TypeScript's internal escaped property name adds a leading underscore; the checker API has `unescapeLeadingUnderscores` / `symbol.name` vs `escapedName`): use the unescaped name, with an exact-content test over names starting with one and two underscores. For each bug: write the FAILING test first (use the existing fake-tsc harness in crates/tsc-client/tests and crates/semantic/tests, and where a real tsc is needed the CALIPER_TEST_TSC pattern with apps/oracle/node_modules/typescript-beta), then the fix; verify with the real typescript@7.1.0-beta on a small fixture and, if the antd/mantine corpora are available under sibling worktrees' .corpora (read-only), re-run the specific props (antd Circle.format, ActionButton.close, Avatar.onClick; Mantine Accordion.__size) and show before/after type text. Do NOT change the structural path. Full CI set: `CI=1 CALIPER_TEST_TSC=<worktree>/apps/oracle/node_modules/typescript-beta/bin/tsc cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `just lint doc-check typos machete`, `just semver`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` first. Changeset per branch (consumer-visible: the checker mode's output, outcome first). Update docs/type-checker-integration.md where it lists these as known gaps. Be CPU-light on corpus runs: another worker is taking performance measurements for trail 192. GPG-signed commits (/usr/bin/git, one plain command per call, sandbox off for git writes, verify %G?=G), never push, never open PRs, never merge. Commit trailer `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_013R2ytvK9B32ZaSUaSe6aAZ`. `caliper-docgen extract --experimental-semantic-types [--tsc-path PATH]`, or `experimentalSemanticTypes` and `tscPath` in `docgen.config.ts`. `crates/semantic` spawns the project's `node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --api` (version pinned to `7.1.0-beta`), builds one program over the files of the components the structural pass fou

- **Merge:** props present, `type` and `required` from the checker; `defaultValue`, `parent`, `declarations`, `tags`, inheritance layers and curated inherited props stay structural. The checker is asked for a prop's description only when the structural pass has none (65% of Mantine's requests otherwise). Props `@types/react` dec
- **Output type:** no new `PropType` variant and no schema change. Primitives, literals, unions (with `boolean` collapsed and `undefined` dropped from optional props), arrays, tuples, inline objects of up to 16 fields and single-signature functions map onto existing variants; `ReactNode`, `ElementType`, `CSSProperties` and `Reac
- **Provenance:** `Info` diagnostics with code `SEMANTIC_BACKEND` whose `affects` lists the output keys: one for the components the checker resolved, one per fallback reason. A first-class per-component field would change the canonical JSON and needs an output schema version first.
- **Fallback:** a missing, unsupported-version, crashed or timed-out `tsc` gives the structural result plus one `SEMANTIC_BACKEND` warning, never an error. Per component, the structural result stands for: not exported, class or non-function, overloaded, no props parameter, `any`/`unknown`/generic/union props type, export not fou
- **Not carried:** optional and rest parameters, index signatures, `readonly` and ref names (`PropType` has them since schema version 4; `convert.rs` doesn't set them), generic parameters of functions, per-prop `tags`, `parent`/`declarations` from the checker. Default exports match by `default` when no export has the component's
- **Tests:** `crates/semantic/tests/replay.rs` runs the backend against `replay-tsc`, which answers from a recording of the real `7.1.0-beta` (`tests/fixtures/recording.json`, refreshed by `cargo run -p caliper-docgen-semantic --example record_fixture -- <typescript package dir>`); a request the recording lacks fails the test. F

Measured on `7.1.0-beta`, `extract --json` (best of 2 to 3), flag on against off, plus the base commit's output compared byte for byte (identical apart from `durationMs` on all five corpora, with and without `--load-dependencies`). Peak RSS is the larger of the two processes; on Chakra Caliper is 117 MiB and `tsc` 945 MiB.
